chunks: ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said: Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
The blind woman, the woman with baras, the woman with leprosy, and the lame woman are returned.

key_terms.تُرَدُّ: may be returned, meaning the marriage may be revoked or annulled

ai.seo_question: Which conditions allow a marriage to be annulled according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning annulment in marriage due to certain physical defects. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that a blind woman, a woman with baras, a woman with leprosy, and a lame woman may be returned, meaning the marriage may be invalidated on account of these conditions.
